q: What is/are 'Western disturbances'?
o: steady winds blowing towards the Equator
e: Western disturbances — winter rain in north-west India.

q: What is/are 'Trade winds'?
o: warm dry wind in the Alps
hot, dry summer winds of north India
steady winds blowing towards the Equator
pre-monsoon showers in Kerala and Karnataka
e: Trade winds — steady winds blowing towards the Equator.

q: Which local or planetary wind is described as winter rain in north-west India?
e: Western disturbances — winter rain in north-west India.

q: What is/are 'Westerlies'?
o: warm wind on the eastern slopes of the Rockies
winds blowing from sub-tropical highs to sub-polar lows
hot, dry summer winds of north India
pre-monsoon showers in Kerala and Karnataka
e: Westerlies — winds blowing from sub-tropical highs to sub-polar lows.

q: What is/are 'Foehn'?
o: hot, dry summer winds of north India
warm dry wind in the Alps
pre-monsoon showers in Kerala and Karnataka
e: Foehn — warm dry wind in the Alps.

q: Which local or planetary wind is described as pre-monsoon showers in Kerala and Karnataka?
e: Mango showers — pre-monsoon showers in Kerala and Karnataka.

q: Which local or planetary wind is described as warm wind on the eastern slopes of the Rockies?
e: Chinook — warm wind on the eastern slopes of the Rockies.

q: Which local or planetary wind is described as warm dry wind in the Alps?
e: Foehn — warm dry wind in the Alps.

q: Which local or planetary wind is described as steady winds blowing towards the Equator?
e: Trade winds — steady winds blowing towards the Equator.
